friend.ruleA: Capable of long-term updates and maintenance, delivering valuable content.
friend.ruleB: Original content. AI assistance is fine, but full AI generation is not accepted.
friend.methodA: Refer to my info and send an email to {email} containing your site's Admin, Title, Bio, URL, and Avatar.
friend.methodB: Developers can also register an account, log in to get a token via cookies, set the request header: ( authorization : token ), request body: ( administrator, title, description, website, avatar ), and send a POST request to https://mortis.uno/api/friend.
friend.tips: For efficiency, please add this site to your links before applying. I will respond within 1 day after submission.
